summary: Displays a visual symbol from Carbon's bundled icon set.

alternatives.when: The icon needs to perform an action rather than convey or support information.

pitfalls: Hide decorative icons from assistive technologies with aria-hidden.
For an icon that conveys meaning on its own, set role to img and provide ariaLabel.
Prefer a semantic color preset over an arbitrary CSS color.

examples.description: Render a decorative icon that is hidden from assistive technologies.
Give a meaningful standalone icon an image role and accessible name.
